candidates.title: Two Voices by the Brook
candidates.key: A minor (Aeolian; a Dorian F# at the lift)
candidates.description: A slow 4/4 duet for two nylon guitars in A minor: the lead sings a long-note air with small ornaments over a rippling brook of arpeggios, the second guitar answers its phrases a tenth below, the B part warms into C major and lifts on a single Dorian D/F#, and the low voice sings the hook before the lead steps back into the loop.

candidates.title: Hearthward
candidates.key: G major (B part through E minor and C)
